'''Galina Vladimirovna Kurlyandskaya''' ({{langx|ru|Галина Владимировна Курляндская}}; born {{Nowrap|30 January}} 1961) is a [[Russians|Russian]] physicist, known for her works on [[giant magnetoimpedance]].<ref>{{Cite web |title=Galina KURLYANDSKAYA :Doctor of Science (Universidad del País Vasco / Euskal Herriko Unibertsitatea, Leioa /UPV/EHU) |url=https://www.researchgate.net/profile/Galina_Kurlyandskaya |access-date=2020-06-12 |website=ResearchGate |language=en |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20151214093950/https://www.researchgate.net/profile/Galina_Kurlyandskaya |archive-date=2015-12-14 |url-status=live }}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |title=G. V. Kurlyandskaya |url=https://ieeexplore.ieee.org/author/37317603700 |access-date=2025-10-06 |website=ieeexplore.ieee.org}}</ref>

== Biography ==
Galina Kurlyandskaya was born in [[Kirovgrad]], [[Soviet Union]], in 1961 in a Russian family.

== Career ==
Kurlyandskaya has published more than 110 [[Peer review|peer-reviewed]] research papers, on topics like design, development, processing and characterization of functional materials, [[nanostructures]], [[biomaterials]], magnetic markers, nanocomponent containing devices, and fabrication of miniature sensor prototypes including fluid containing detectors and imprint circuit units, and microscopy.<ref>{{Cite web |title=Kurlyandskaya, Galina Vladimirovna Researc Portal |url=https://sciencedata.urfu.ru/portal/ru/persons/--(c70a6012-987f-45a1-98ba-48a4d8fa0ba4)/publications.html?pageSize=10&page=1&ordering=researchOutputOrderByTitle&descending=false |website=Ural Federal University}}</ref>

Kurlyandskaya is a member of the editorial board of ''Sensor Letters'' journal (American Scientific Publishers, a company identified as a [[predatory publisher]] on [[Beall's List]].<ref>[http://openscience.ens.fr/ABOUT_OPEN_ACCESS/BLOGS/2017_01_23_Jeffrey_Beall_last_list_of_predatory_journals.pdf Beall's list]</ref>)

* Kurlyandskaya G.V. and Cerdeira M.A. Magnetic nanoparticles as a material for magnetic markers in biology and medicine, in: Magnetism of Rare Earth and 3d- Transition Metals Based Nanosystems / Ed. by. V.O. Vas´kovskiy, Editorial of Ural State University Ekaterinburg, 2008.
